tier.rationale: Overall T4 (discriminator confirmed 2026-10-29 on source-read evidence; per-jurisdiction census completed at seal attempt 3 and re-checked at seal attempts 4, 5 and 6, 2026-10-30 to 2026-11-02; mandate sealed 2026-11-02 with all 65 questions answered; the limbs reopened and closed at seal attempt 6 (US-MQ-26 CT, US-MQ-45 MS, US-MQ-57 OR) bear on no tier; Stage-5 re-check 2026-11-02: superseded citations re-pointed to their S5 successors, census unchanged (new local layers found only inside T4 states: Lexington KY, Greenwood Village and Glendale CO OPT), and the five prevailing-wage limbs reopened that day (US-MQ-30 GA, 32 IA, 45 MS, 47 NC, 64 UT) and closed at the reseal the same day bear on no tier). Employer-operation test: T4 requires a second independent calculation AND a separate remittance/return to a second authority. Federal: 26 U.S.C. 3402(a)(1) obliges every employer to withhold federal income tax under IRS tables and covers federal tax only [US-FED-012]; FICA and FUTA go on federal returns 941/944/940 [US-FED-005, US-FED-007, US-FED-015]. State: a wage-taxing state imposes its own withholding computed on its own basis (e.g. Va. Code 58.1-461 [US-VAPIT-002]) remitted to the state revenue authority on its own returns (Virginia Tax VA-5/VA-6 [US-VAPIT-003]); state UI is a separate state tax base and agency (Fla. Stat. 443.1216 [US-MULTI-001]; SC Code ch. 41-31 [US-SCS5-015]). Nothing is absorbed into the federal deduction (contrast Switzerland, StHG Art. 36a Abs. 1, where one deduction discharges all levels). FUTA is federal but its credit depends on state UI paid and on the state's Title XII loan status (26 U.S.C. 3302(c)(2) [US-FED-014]): a cross-layer dependency, so futa is T3. Inside a state, a local layer is T4 where a locality receives a separate return (City of Portland Metro SHS / Multnomah PFA [US-ORS5-004]; Ohio municipal income tax, ORC 718.03 [US-OHP52-003]; Pennsylvania Act 32 EIT/LST to the local collector [US-PA-004]; Jersey City and Newark employer payroll taxes on quarterly city returns [US-NJP6-001, US-NJP6-002]) and T3 where it is piggybacked on the state return (Maryland county tax on MW506 [US-MDP51-001]; NYC and Yonkers on NYS-45/NYS-1 [US-NY-008]). Consequence: the federal core and each jurisdiction are declared and scoped as parallel layers, and the multistate domain routes each employee to one or more of them. Jurisdiction annexes (re-checked 2026-10-30, seal attempt 5): 9 T1 (no state wage tax; SUI and levies only: AK, FL, NH, NV, SD, TN, TX, WA, WY; WA declares the Seattle payroll expense tax, a threshold-conditional employer tax on a city return [US-WAP51-001], as a T4-shaped element), 31 T3 (state withholding, local layer absent or piggybacked on the state return), 11 T4 (local layer remitted to the locality on its own return: AL occupational taxes [US-ALP51-001], CO Denver OPT [US-COP52-001], DE Wilmington [US-DEP52-001], KY occupational taxes [US-KYP52-002], MI 23 self-administering cities [US-MIP52-002], MO St. Louis/Kansas City [US-MOP52-006], NJ Jersey City/Newark employer payroll taxes filed with the city [US-NJP6-001, US-NJP6-002], OH [US-OHP52-003], OR [US-ORS5-004], PA [US-PA-004], WV municipal service fees withheld and remitted to the city, W. Va. Code 8-13-13 [US-WVR3-001], Charleston [US-WVR3-002]); 0 unclassified; no classification rests on MANUAL/gated evidence.
